name: Ling Chinfei
source:
[b]Workplace:[/b] Karen
[b]Favorite ramen:[/b] Tokyo-style Soy Sauce Tonkotsu Ramen
[b]Hobby:[/b] Karate (Brown Belt)

A Chinese girl working part-time at Karen. She supposedly came to Japan with a grand ambition, but has gotten so used to life in Japan that she has completely forgotten it. Although she constantly radiates a "fake Chinese girl" aura, she is actually the real deal.
